title: campylotheca collina
intro: Campylotheca collina, commonly known as the Yellow Bird or Yellow Bird Tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Ochnaceae, native to tropical Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including reducing fever and relieving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Campylotheca collina include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
